name: dndgpt-system-rebirth
description: Play RPG campaigns in ChatGPT with a persistent character and campaign dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Play a tabletop-style RPG with ChatGPT as your Game Master. Build your character, explore a world, and track your abilities, allies, inventory, quests and story in one dashboard. Sign in to save your campaign and continue where you left off.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DnDGPT V1.0 rules. Do not start or resume any campaign until I explicitly authorize it.
